# ADR-042 — Canonical all-day event recurrence: `start_date` authoritative, DTSTART anchored at local noon, one shared rule builder

**Status:** Locked

<!-- Decision text below is verbatim from the pre-split docs/DECISIONS.md table row (2026-09-16). Do not edit a Locked decision without explicit owner approval. -->

**Canonical all-day event recurrence.** An all-day event's `start_date`/`end_date` are authoritative and `starts_at`/`ends_at` remain NULL — `starts_at` is **never** written for an all-day event, including to make recurrence work. The recurrence engine anchors an all-day series' DTSTART at **local noon** derived from `start_date` (the convention already documented on `DueDateRecurrenceRule.dtstart` but previously unused), which is DST-safe and correct in nonexistent-midnight zones such as America/Santiago. One shared builder, `buildEventRecurrenceRule` in `packages/core/src/recurrence/event-recurrence.ts`, is the **only** place a stored event row becomes a recurrence rule, and on-demand expansion (`assembleEventRange`), nightly worker materialization, create/PATCH materialization, and occurrence-validity checks (`isValidOccurrence`) all use it — a split-brain recurrence model is forbidden. For `is_recurring_instance && all_day`, `EventRangeItem.start_date`/`end_date` are **re-pointed to that instance's actual calendar dates** (preserving the template's day-span), deliberately asymmetric with timed instances (whose `starts_at`/`ends_at` stay the series template and are positioned by `occurs_at`), because the frozen `EventRangeItem`/`TodayEventItem`/`AgendaItem` shapes carry no per-instance date field and the instance date would otherwise be inexpressible. Pure calendar dates never round-trip through a UTC instant (Checkpoint 5.4, user-approved 2026-08-22)
